lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators across Zimbabwe on a monthly basis (February, June, October 2017) through field assessments and integrated analysis of food security indicators. Geographic polygons with IPC phase classifications represent spatial distribution of acute food insecurity severity across administrative units.
